cmd:file.new.desc: Creates a new document, choosing page size, margins, columns, bleed and the number of pages.
cmd:file.new.label: Document…
cmd:file.new.params: {preset?: "Letter"|"A4"|…, width?, height?, pages?, facingPages?, columns?, gutter?, margins?: number|{top,bottom,inside,outside}, bleed?, title?}

cmd:file.newSample.desc: Opens a multi-page magazine sample document to explore or experiment with.
cmd:file.newSample.label: Sample Document

cmd:file.presets.desc: Works with the saved document presets used when creating new documents.
cmd:file.presets.label: Document Presets

cmd:file.open.desc: Opens an existing document file, including an InDesign IDML package.
cmd:file.open.label: Open…

cmd:file.openBytes.desc: Opens a document from raw file data instead of a path on disk.
cmd:file.openBytes.label: Open Bytes
cmd:file.openBytes.params: {name, base64} — DesignCraft JSON or an IDML package

cmd:file.save.desc: Saves the current document to its file, asking where if it has none.
cmd:file.save.label: Save

cmd:file.saveAs.desc: Saves the current document to a new file or location you choose.
cmd:file.saveAs.label: Save As…

cmd:file.saveACopy.desc: Writes a copy of the document to a file without switching to it.
cmd:file.saveACopy.label: Save a Copy…
cmd:file.saveACopy.params: {path} — writes the document without changing which file it is or its unsaved state

cmd:file.revert.desc: Discards all unsaved changes and reloads the last saved version of the document.
cmd:file.revert.label: Revert
cmd:file.revert.params: {} — back to the last saved version (not undoable)

cmd:file.recovery.list.desc: Lists unsaved documents left behind after the app crashed or closed unexpectedly.
cmd:file.recovery.list.label: Recovery Data
cmd:file.recovery.list.params: {dir?} → [{uid, path, title, saved}] unsaved documents left by a crash (default: the session's recovery folder)

cmd:file.recovery.save.desc: Writes every unsaved document to the recovery folder so a crash loses nothing.
cmd:file.recovery.save.label: Save Recovery Data
cmd:file.recovery.save.params: {dir?} — write every unsaved document to the recovery folder (the app does this on a timer)

cmd:file.recovery.open.desc: Reopens documents that were saved to the recovery folder after a crash.
cmd:file.recovery.open.label: Recover Documents
cmd:file.recovery.open.params: {dir?} — reopen documents left in the recovery folder (unsaved)

cmd:file.serialize.label: Serialize
cmd:file.serialize.desc: Get the document file as base64 data for saving or transfer.

cmd:file.activate.desc: Makes another open document the active one for editing.
cmd:file.activate.label: Activate Document

cmd:snippet.export.desc: Saves the selected items with their styles and images as a reusable snippet file.
cmd:snippet.export.label: Export Selection as Snippet
cmd:snippet.export.params: {path?} — the selected items (with their stories, styles and images) as a .designcraft snippet; no path: {base64}

cmd:place.styles.desc: Lists the paragraph and character styles a Word or RTF file will bring when imported.
cmd:place.styles.label: Import Options: Styles
cmd:place.styles.params: {path | base64, name} → {paragraph: [name], character: [name], conflicts: [name]} — the styles a Word/RTF file brings (for styleMap / styleConflicts)

cmd:snippet.place.desc: Places a saved snippet of items back into the layout at a chosen spot.
cmd:snippet.place.label: Place Snippet
cmd:snippet.place.params: {path | base64, spread?, x?, y?} — items keep their positions unless x/y given (top-left)

cmd:place.load.desc: Loads a graphic into the place cursor so you can click or drag to position it.
cmd:place.load.label: Load Place Cursor
cmd:place.load.params: {path | base64, name?} — load a graphic into the place cursor (then click/drag with the placeGun tool)

cmd:place.drop.desc: Drops the graphic waiting on the place cursor into the page at a position.
cmd:place.drop.label: Place Loaded Graphic

cmd:file.place.desc: Places an image or file into the layout, optionally inside a selected frame.
cmd:file.place.label: Place…
cmd:file.place.params: {path?|base64?, name?, frame?: id (place into), spread?, x?, y?, width?, pdfPage?: n (1-based, Image Import Options), pdfCrop?: crop|trim|bleed|art|media, layoutPage?: n (IDML / .designcraft: that page's objects as a group)} — places an image (into the selected empty frame if any); text files (.txt, .docx, .rtf, .md) and Excel workbooks (.xlsx, as a table) go into the insertion point, the selected frame or a new frame on `page`/`rect` — {autoflow?: adds pages with threaded frames until the text fits, removeStyles?, styleMap?: {imported name: document style}, styleConflicts?: useExisting|redefine|autoRename}

cmd:file.exportIdml.desc: Saves the document as an InDesign IDML package for exchange with other apps.
cmd:file.exportIdml.label: Export IDML…
cmd:file.exportIdml.params: {path?, embedImages?: true} — writes an IDML package to `path`, or returns {base64} without a path

cmd:file.openIdml.desc: Opens an InDesign IDML package as a new editable document.
cmd:file.openIdml.label: Open IDML
cmd:file.openIdml.params: {path | base64, name?} — opens an IDML package as a new document (linked images are read next to the file or from its Links/ folder)

cmd:file.exportPdf.label: Export PDF…
cmd:file.exportPdf.params: {path?, pages?: "1-3,5" | [1,3] (1-based positions; default all), flatten?: high|medium|low|ppi (Transparency Flattener: spreads with transparency are rasterised), spreads?: bool, fullScreen?: bool, bookmarksPanel?: bool, pageLayout?: single|continuous|twoUp|twoUpCover|twoUpContinuous, view?: fitPage|fitWidth|actual, advanceSeconds?: number (interactive PDF), bleed?: bool (document bleed), marks?: bool | {crop?, bleed?, pageInfo?, weight?, offset?}, standard?: "none"|"x4"|"a2b", compressImages?: bool, tagged?: bool (structure tree: stories as paragraphs, figures with alt text), media?: bool (interactive: embed placed video and sound), title?, author?} → {path, bytes, pages, warnings} (no path: {base64, …})
cmd:file.exportPdf.desc: Export the document as a PDF with chosen pages, spreads and flattening options.

cmd:file.exportEpub.desc: Exports the document as a reflowable EPUB ebook, optionally using the first page as cover.
cmd:file.exportEpub.label: Export EPUB (Reflowable)…
cmd:file.exportEpub.params: {path?, title?, author?, language?: "en", cover?: bool (the first page as the cover image), fixedLayout?: bool (pre-paginated: each page as an image with its text)} → {path, bytes} (no path: {base64, bytes})

cmd:file.exportFixedEpub.desc: Exports a fixed-layout EPUB where each page keeps its exact designed appearance.
cmd:file.exportFixedEpub.label: Export EPUB (Fixed Layout)…
cmd:file.exportFixedEpub.params: {path?, title?, author?, language?} — pre-paginated EPUB → {path, bytes} (no path: {base64, bytes})

cmd:file.printBooklet.desc: Imposes the pages in booklet order and prints them as a printer-spread PDF.
cmd:file.printBooklet.label: Print Booklet…
cmd:file.printBooklet.params: {path?, type?: saddleStitch|twoUpConsecutive, spaceBetween? (pt)} — printer spreads as PDF (pages imposed in booklet order) → {path, bytes, sheets} (no path: {base64, …})

cmd:file.exportHtml.desc: Exports the document as one self-contained HTML page with inline styles and embedded images.
cmd:file.exportHtml.label: Export HTML…
cmd:file.exportHtml.params: {path?, title?, language?} — one self-contained page (styles inline, images embedded), stories and graphics in reading order → {path, bytes} (no path: {text, bytes})

cmd:file.exportText.desc: Exports a story's text as plain text, RTF or tagged text.
cmd:file.exportText.label: Export Text…
cmd:file.exportText.params: {path?, format?: "txt"|"rtf"|"tagged" (Tagged Text; default from the path, else txt), story?, frame?} — the story being edited or of the selected frame → {path, bytes} (no path: {text, bytes})

cmd:edit.undo.label: Undo
cmd:edit.undo.desc: Reverse the most recent change and restore the document to its previous state.

cmd:edit.redo.desc: Reapplies the last change that was undone.
cmd:edit.redo.label: Redo

cmd:selection.set.desc: Selects specific items on the page, optionally adding them to the current selection.
cmd:selection.set.label: Select

cmd:selection.toggle.desc: Selects an item that is not selected, or deselects it if it is.
cmd:selection.toggle.label: Toggle Selection

cmd:edit.selectAll.desc: Selects every item on the active spreads, or all the text in the story.
cmd:edit.selectAll.label: Select All
cmd:edit.selectAll.params: {} — all items on the active spreads, or all text in the story

cmd:edit.deselectAll.desc: Clears the selection so that nothing is selected.
cmd:edit.deselectAll.label: Deselect All

cmd:edit.clear.desc: Deletes the selected items or the selected text.
cmd:edit.clear.label: Clear
cmd:edit.clear.params: {ids?} — delete selected items (or the selected text)

cmd:edit.copy.desc: Copies the selection to the clipboard, keeping text formatting and footnotes.
cmd:edit.copy.label: Copy
cmd:edit.copy.params: {} → {text} when text is selected (with formatting, footnotes, markers)

cmd:edit.cut.desc: Removes the selection and places it on the clipboard.
cmd:edit.cut.label: Cut

cmd:edit.pasteWithoutFormatting.desc: Pastes text as plain text, taking on the formatting already at the insertion point.
cmd:edit.pasteWithoutFormatting.label: Paste without Formatting
cmd:edit.pasteWithoutFormatting.params: {text?} — plain text at the insertion point, in the format there

cmd:edit.paste.desc: Pastes clipboard content at the insertion point or onto the page.
cmd:edit.paste.label: Paste
cmd:edit.paste.params: {inPlace?: bool, text?: the system clipboard's text (pastes it unless it is what was copied here)}

cmd:edit.pasteInto.desc: Pastes the copied objects as the content of a frame, clipped by it.
cmd:edit.pasteInto.label: Paste Into
cmd:edit.pasteInto.params: {id?} — the copied objects become the content of the selected frame (or `id`), clipped by it

cmd:edit.pasteInPlace.desc: Pastes the content at the exact position the copy came from.
cmd:edit.pasteInPlace.label: Paste in Place

cmd:edit.duplicate.desc: Makes a copy of the selection as a new object.
cmd:edit.duplicate.label: Duplicate

cmd:endnote.insert.desc: Adds an endnote reference at the insertion point and collects its text at the document end.
cmd:endnote.insert.label: Insert Endnote
cmd:endnote.insert.params: {text?} — a reference at the insertion point; the first one makes the endnote frame on a new last page → {story, id, frame}

cmd:endnote.edit.desc: Changes the text of an existing endnote.
cmd:endnote.edit.label: Edit Endnote

cmd:endnote.delete.desc: Removes an endnote's reference mark and its text.
cmd:endnote.delete.label: Delete Endnote
cmd:endnote.delete.params: {story, id} — removes the reference and its text

cmd:endnote.list.desc: Lists every endnote in the document in numbering order.
cmd:endnote.list.label: Endnotes
cmd:endnote.list.params: {} → [{story, id, number, text}] in numbering order

cmd:endnote.options.desc: Sets endnote numbering style, start number, prefixes, heading and separator options.
cmd:endnote.options.label: Document Endnote Options…
cmd:endnote.options.params: {style?: arabic|upperRoman|lowerRoman|upperLetters|lowerLetters, startAt?, prefix?, suffix?, heading?, headingStyle?, paraStyle?, separator?} → the options

cmd:note.new.desc: Inserts an anchored note with author and text at the insertion point.
cmd:note.new.label: New Note
cmd:note.new.params: {text, author?} — at the insertion point → {story, id}

cmd:note.edit.desc: Changes the text or author of an existing note.
cmd:note.edit.label: Edit Note

cmd:note.delete.desc: Removes a note from the text.
cmd:note.delete.label: Delete Note

cmd:note.convertToText.desc: Turns a note into ordinary text that replaces its anchor in the story.
cmd:note.convertToText.label: Convert Note to Text
cmd:note.convertToText.params: {story, id} — the note's text replaces its anchor

cmd:note.list.desc: Lists all notes in story order with their authors and text.
cmd:note.list.label: Notes
cmd:note.list.params: {} → [{story, id, at, author, text}] in story order

cmd:frame.create.desc: Draws a new frame as a rectangle, ellipse or polygon, holding text or a graphic.
cmd:frame.create.label: Create Frame
cmd:frame.create.params: {spread?, rect: [x0,y0,x1,y1] (spread coords), shape?: rectangle|ellipse|polygon, content?: graphic|text|unassigned, sides?: 6, text?: string, caret?: bool}

cmd:line.create.desc: Draws a straight line between two points on the spread.
cmd:line.create.label: Create Line

cmd:transform.move.desc: Moves the selected items by a horizontal and vertical distance, optionally leaving copies.
cmd:transform.move.label: Move

cmd:transform.resize.desc: Resizes items to new bounds, optionally scaling their content or spreading centres evenly.
cmd:transform.resize.label: Resize
cmd:transform.resize.params: {from: rect, to: rect, content?: bool (scale content), distribute?: bool (Live Distribute: objects keep their size, their centres spread with the bounds), ids?}

cmd:transform.rotate.desc: Rotates the selected items by an angle around their centre.
cmd:transform.rotate.label: Rotate

cmd:transform.scale.desc: Scales the selected items wider or taller around their centre.
cmd:transform.scale.label: Scale

cmd:transform.again.desc: Repeats the last transformation, or the whole sequence, on the current selection.
cmd:transform.again.label: Transform Again
cmd:transform.again.params: {individually?: bool, sequence?: bool, ids?} — repeat the last transform (or the whole sequence applied to this selection), on the selection as a whole or on each object about its own centre

cmd:transform.clear.desc: Removes rotation, shear and scaling from the selected objects, keeping their centre.
cmd:transform.clear.label: Clear Transformations
cmd:transform.clear.params: {ids?} — remove rotation, shear and scaling (the object keeps its centre)

cmd:transform.shear.desc: Slants or skews the selected objects by an angle.
cmd:transform.shear.label: Shear

cmd:object.matchAttributes.desc: Copies fill, stroke, opacity, effects and wrap from one object onto the others, like the eyedropper.
cmd:object.matchAttributes.label: Apply Attributes (Eyedropper)
cmd:object.matchAttributes.params: {from: id, ids?} — copy fill, stroke, corners, opacity, effects, wrap

cmd:transform.flip.desc: Flips the selected objects horizontally or vertically like a mirror.
cmd:transform.flip.label: Flip

cmd:transform.set.label: Transform Panel
cmd:transform.set.params: {x?, y?, width?, height?, scaleX? (%), scaleY? (%), rotation? (°), shear? (°), ref?: 0..8, ids?} — reference-point based geometry; rotation and shear are absolute (Transformations are Totals decides whether nested objects measure them on the pasteboard)
cmd:transform.set.desc: Set an object's position, size, scale, rotation and shear numerically.

cmd:transform.info.desc: Reports the current scale, rotation and shear of the selected object.
cmd:transform.info.label: Transform Values
cmd:transform.info.params: {ids?} → {scaleX, scaleY (%), rotation, shear (°), content?: the same for a placed graphic} of the first target

cmd:object.arrange.label: Arrange
cmd:object.arrange.desc: Move objects in front of or behind other objects in the stacking order.

cmd:object.bringToFront.desc: Puts the selected objects in front of everything else.
cmd:object.bringToFront.label: Bring to Front

cmd:object.bringForward.desc: Raises the selected objects one step up the stacking order.
cmd:object.bringForward.label: Bring Forward

cmd:object.sendBackward.desc: Lowers the selected objects one step down the stacking order.
cmd:object.sendBackward.label: Send Backward

cmd:object.sendToBack.desc: Puts the selected objects behind everything else.
cmd:object.sendToBack.label: Send to Back

cmd:object.group.desc: Combines the selected objects into one group that moves and transforms together.
cmd:object.group.label: Group

cmd:object.ungroup.desc: Breaks a group apart into its individual objects.
cmd:object.ungroup.label: Ungroup

cmd:object.lock.desc: Locks the selected objects so they cannot be moved or edited by accident.
cmd:object.lock.label: Lock

cmd:object.unlockAll.desc: Unlocks every locked object on the current spread.
cmd:object.unlockAll.label: Unlock All on Spread

cmd:object.hide.desc: Hides the selected objects from view without deleting them.
cmd:object.hide.label: Hide

cmd:object.showAll.desc: Makes all hidden objects on the spread visible again.
cmd:object.showAll.label: Show All on Spread

cmd:object.setFlags.desc: Sets the hidden or locked flag on objects, like the eye and lock icons in the Layers panel.
cmd:object.setFlags.label: Set Visibility / Lock
cmd:object.setFlags.params: {ids: [id], hidden?: bool, locked?: bool} — Layers panel eye/lock per object

cmd:object.fill.desc: Applies a colour swatch and tint to the fill of the selected objects.
cmd:object.fill.label: Fill

cmd:object.stroke.desc: Styles the outline of objects with weight, colour, alignment, dashes, caps and arrowheads.
cmd:object.stroke.label: Stroke
cmd:object.stroke.params: {swatch?, tint?, weight?, align?: center|inside|outside, type?: {kind:…}, cap?: butt|round|projecting, join?: miter|round|bevel, miterLimit?, start?, end?: none|simple|simpleWide|triangle|triangleWide|barbed|curved|circle|circleSolid|square|squareSolid|bar, gapSwatch?, gapTint?, gapOverprint?: bool, ids?}

cmd:object.opacity.desc: Sets how transparent objects are and their blend mode.
cmd:object.opacity.label: Opacity

cmd:object.dropShadow.desc: Adds or adjusts a drop shadow with distance, angle, size, spread and colour.
cmd:object.dropShadow.label: Drop Shadow
cmd:object.dropShadow.params: {on?: bool, distance?, angle?, globalLight?: bool, opacity?, size?, spread? (%), color? (swatch), ids?}

cmd:object.innerShadow.desc: Adds or adjusts a shadow inside the edges of the object.
cmd:object.innerShadow.label: Inner Shadow
cmd:object.innerShadow.params: {on?: bool, distance?, angle?, globalLight?: bool, opacity?, size?, choke? (%), color?, ids?}

cmd:object.outerGlow.desc: Adds or adjusts a soft glow around the outside of the object.
cmd:object.outerGlow.label: Outer Glow
cmd:object.outerGlow.params: {on?: bool, opacity?, size?, spread? (%), color?, ids?}

cmd:object.exportOptions.desc: Sets per-object export settings such as alt text, rasterizing and page breaks for PDF and EPUB.
cmd:object.exportOptions.label: Object Export Options…
cmd:object.exportOptions.params: {ids?, artifact?: bool (tagged PDF decoration), rasterize?: bool (EPUB/HTML image), align?: left|center|right|"", pageBreakBefore?: bool, altText?}

cmd:object.innerGlow.desc: Adds or adjusts a glow inside the edges of the object, optionally from the centre.
cmd:object.innerGlow.label: Inner Glow
cmd:object.innerGlow.params: {on?: bool, opacity?, size?, choke? (%), center?: bool (glow from the centre), color?, ids?}

cmd:object.bevel.desc: Adds or adjusts a bevel and emboss effect with depth, angle, highlight and shadow.
cmd:object.bevel.label: Bevel and Emboss
cmd:object.bevel.params: {on?: bool, size?, depth? (%), angle?, globalLight?: bool, highlight?, highlightOpacity?, shadow?, shadowOpacity?, ids?}

cmd:object.satin.desc: Adds or adjusts a satin effect that shades the object with soft curved ripples.
cmd:object.satin.label: Satin
cmd:object.satin.params: {on?: bool, opacity?, angle?, distance?, size?, invert?: bool, color?, ids?}

cmd:object.directionalFeather.desc: Fades the object's edges softly with separate amounts for each side.
cmd:object.directionalFeather.label: Directional Feather
cmd:object.directionalFeather.params: {on?: bool, widths?: [top, left, bottom, right] | number, ids?}

cmd:object.feather.desc: Fades all edges of the object softly by a set width.
cmd:object.feather.label: Basic Feather

cmd:object.content.desc: Changes what a frame holds, choosing text, a graphic or unassigned.
cmd:object.content.label: Content

cmd:object.textFrameOptions.desc: Sets text frame options such as columns, insets, vertical justification and auto-size.
cmd:object.textFrameOptions.label: Text Frame Options…
cmd:object.textFrameOptions.params: {columns?, gutter?, inset?: number|[t,l,b,r], verticalJustification?: top|center|bottom|justify, firstBaseline?, autoSize?, ignoreWrap?, balanceColumns?, vertical?: bool (Vertical Type), ids?}

cmd:object.cornerOptions.desc: Rounds or reshapes the corners of frames with styles like rounded, bevel or fancy.
cmd:object.cornerOptions.label: Corner Options…

cmd:object.textWrap.desc: Makes text wrap around an object, following its box or its actual shape.
cmd:object.textWrap.label: Text Wrap

cmd:object.fit.desc: Fits the frame or its content proportionally, fills the frame or centres the content.
cmd:object.fit.label: Fitting

cmd:object.fittingOptions.desc: Sets default frame fitting such as auto-fit, crop amounts and a reference point for placed images.
cmd:object.fittingOptions.label: Frame Fitting Options…
cmd:object.fittingOptions.params: {autoFit?: bool, fitting?: none|fillProportionally|fitProportionally|fitContentToFrame|centerContent, align?: 0..8 (reference point, 4 = centre), crop?: n | [t, l, b, r] (negative adds space), ids?}

cmd:object.rename.desc: Gives an object a new name shown in panels.
cmd:object.rename.label: Rename

cmd:edit.stepAndRepeat.label: Step and Repeat…
cmd:edit.stepAndRepeat.params: {count?: 1, dx?, dy?, rows?, columns?, ids?} — copies of the selection (or ids) offset by (dx, dy); with rows/columns, a grid
cmd:edit.stepAndRepeat.desc: Make multiple offset copies of the selection, or a grid of copies by rows and columns.

cmd:path.create.desc: Draws a new vector path from anchor points, optionally closed.
cmd:path.create.label: Create Path

cmd:path.appendAnchor.desc: Adds an anchor point with handles to the end of a path.
cmd:path.appendAnchor.label: Add Anchor

cmd:path.close.desc: Closes an open path by joining its ends into a shape.
cmd:path.close.label: Close Path

cmd:path.moveAnchors.desc: Moves chosen anchor points or their handles of a path by a distance.
cmd:path.moveAnchors.label: Move Anchors
cmd:path.moveAnchors.params: {id, anchors: [[subpath, index]], dx, dy, handle?: in|out}

cmd:object.align.desc: Aligns objects along an edge, to each other, a key object, the margins or the page.
cmd:object.align.label: Align

cmd:object.distribute.desc: Spreads objects out evenly by their centres or by a fixed spacing.
cmd:object.distribute.label: Distribute
cmd:object.distribute.params: {axis: horizontal|vertical, by?: centers|spacing, spacing?: points, ids?}

cmd:tool.polygonSettings.desc: Sets how many sides new polygons have and how pointed a star shape is.
cmd:tool.polygonSettings.label: Polygon Settings…
cmd:tool.polygonSettings.params: {sides?: 3–100, starInset?: 0–100 (%)} → the settings new polygons use

cmd:gap.move.label: Move Gap

cmd:frame.grid.desc: Creates a grid of frames filling a rectangle, with set columns, rows and gutter.
cmd:frame.grid.label: Gridify

cmd:object.clippingPath.desc: Traces an image's alpha or background and turns the outline into a clipping frame.
cmd:object.clippingPath.label: Clipping Path…

cmd:object.primaryTextFrame.desc: Marks a text frame as primary so pages are added or removed automatically as text flows.
cmd:object.primaryTextFrame.label: Primary Text Frame
cmd:object.primaryTextFrame.params: {on?: bool (default: toggle), ids?} — the selected text frame's story becomes the primary story (Smart Text Reflow adds and removes pages for it)

cmd:object.attributes.desc: Sets overprint for fill, stroke or gap, and marks an object non-printing.
cmd:object.attributes.label: Attributes
cmd:object.attributes.params: {overprintFill?, overprintStroke?, overprintGap?, nonprinting?: bool, ids?} — Attributes panel

cmd:object.globalLight.desc: Sets the shared light angle used by all effects that follow global light.
cmd:object.globalLight.label: Global Light…
cmd:object.globalLight.params: {angle} — the light angle shared by shadows that use Global Light

cmd:object.label.desc: Attaches a free-text script label to objects so scripts can find them.
cmd:object.label.label: Script Label
cmd:object.label.params: {label, ids?} — free text scripts and agents can find objects by

cmd:object.altText.desc: Sets alternative text describing the object for tagged PDF and EPUB.
cmd:object.altText.label: Object Export Options
cmd:object.altText.params: {text, ids?} — alternative text for tagged PDF and EPUB

cmd:object.transparencyGroup.desc: Sets a group to isolate blending or knock out, controlling how members blend together.
cmd:object.transparencyGroup.label: Group Transparency
cmd:object.transparencyGroup.params: {isolate?: bool, knockout?: bool, ids?} — Effects panel: Isolate Blending, Knockout Group

cmd:object.findByLabel.desc: Finds the ids of objects carrying a given script label.
cmd:object.findByLabel.label: Find by Script Label
cmd:object.findByLabel.params: {label} → ids of objects whose label is `label`

cmd:object.setLayer.desc: Moves the selected objects to another layer.
cmd:object.setLayer.label: Move to Layer

cmd:path.addAnchor.desc: Adds an anchor point at a spot on an existing path.
cmd:path.addAnchor.label: Add Anchor Point
cmd:path.addAnchor.params: {id, at: [x,y] (spread coords; the nearest point on the path), tolerance?: pt (default 4)} → {subpath, anchor}

cmd:path.deleteAnchor.desc: Deletes an anchor point from a path, removing the object if no path is left.
cmd:path.deleteAnchor.label: Delete Anchor Point
cmd:path.deleteAnchor.params: {id, subpath, anchor} — removes the point (and the object when no path is left)

cmd:path.convertAnchor.desc: Switches an anchor between a smooth curve point and a sharp corner, or drags out handles.
cmd:path.convertAnchor.label: Convert Direction Point

cmd:path.smooth.desc: Refits a stretch of path with fewer, smoother anchor points along the dragged area.

tool:get_story.desc: Full text of a story plus its frames, paragraph count, line count and overset position. Identify it by `story` id or by a text `frame` id (default: the selection).

tool:inspect_document.text0: Summary of the active document: settings, pages (index, name, bounds, margins, columns), spreads with items (id, kind, bounds, fill, stroke, story), stories (id, frames, length, overset, preview), layers, paragraph/character styles, swatches, selection, active tool.
tool:inspect_document.desc: Summary of the active document: settings, pages (index, name, bounds, margins, columns), spreads with items (id, kind, bounds, fill, stroke, story), stories (id, frames, length, overset, preview), layers, paragraph/character styles, swatches, selection, active tool.

tool:key.text0: Press a key with modifiers, e.g. {key:"Z", cmd:true} (undo), {key:"Escape"}, {key:"Enter"}, {key:"Left", shift:true}. In the desktop app it goes through the real keyboard path; headless it goes to the active tool (caret keys while typing), then command shortcuts, then tool shortcuts.
tool:key.desc: Press a key with modifiers, e.g. {key:"Z", cmd:true} (undo), {key:"Escape"}, {key:"Enter"}, {key:"Left", shift:true}. tool:list_commands.text0: List DesignCraft commands: id, label, menu path, shortcut, parameter description and whether it can run right now. Every user-visible action is a command (frame.create, text.insert, type.char, style.paragraph.apply, layout.pages.insert, object.fill, transform.move, edit.undo…); run them with execute or batch.
tool:list_commands.desc: List DesignCraft commands: id, label, menu path, shortcut, parameter description and whether it can run right now. tool:menu_list.text0: The menu bar tree (menus, entries as cmd:/ui: command ids, separators, submenus). Desktop app only (`designcraft-cli mcp --connect PORT`).
tool:menu_list.desc: The menu bar tree (menus, entries as cmd:/ui: command ids, separators, submenus). Desktop app only (`designcraft-cli mcp --connect PORT`).

tool:new_document.params: {bleed?:number, columns?:integer, facingPages?:boolean, gutter?:number, height?:number, margins?, pages?:integer, preset?:string, sample?:boolean, title?:string, width?:number}
tool:new_document.text0: Create a new document and make it active. Sizes are in points (72 pt = 1 in). sample:true opens the multi-page magazine sample instead.
tool:new_document.desc: Create a new document and make it active. Sizes are in points (72 pt = 1 in). sample:true opens the multi-page magazine sample instead.

tool:open_document.text0: Open a .designcraft file as a new, active document.
tool:open_document.desc: Open a .designcraft file as a new, active document.

tool:place_image.params: {base64?:string, frame?:integer, name?:string, path?:string, spread?:integer, width?:number, x?:number, y?:number}
tool:place_image.text0: Place an image (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, TIFF) from a file `path` or `base64` data. It goes into `frame` (or the selected empty/graphic frame), otherwise into a new frame at x, y (default: the page's top-left margin) with an optional width.
tool:place_image.desc: Place an image (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, TIFF) from a file `path` or `base64` data. It goes into `frame` (or the selected empty/graphic frame), otherwise into a new frame at x, y (default: the page's top-left margin) with an optional width.

tool:pointer.text0: Drive the active tool with mouse events, exactly like the mouse would. Coordinates are spread points (space "doc", default) or, in the desktop app, screen points (space "screen"). Example: a text frame with the type tool: {tool:"type", events:[{kind:"down",x:72,y:72},{kind:"drag",x:300,y:200},{kind:"up",x:300,y:200}]} leaves a caret in the new frame, ready for type_text. Returns the selection and the active tool.
tool:pointer.desc: Drive the active tool with mouse events, exactly like the mouse would. Coordinates are spread points (space "doc", default) or, in the desktop app, screen points (space "screen"). Example: a text frame with the type tool: {tool:"type", events:[{kind:"down",x:72,y:72},{kind:"drag",x:300,y:200},{kind:"up",x:300,y:200}]} leaves a caret in the new frame, ready for type_text. Returns the selection and the active tool.

tool:render_page.text0: Render one page of the active document (printing items only, like Preview) and return it as a PNG image. Optionally also write it to `path`.
tool:render_page.desc: Render one page of the active document (printing items only, like Preview) and return it as a PNG image. Optionally also write it to `path`.

tool:save_document.text0: Save the active document in the native .designcraft format.
tool:save_document.desc: Save the active document in the native .designcraft format.

tool:screenshot.text0: Capture the whole app window (menus, panels, canvas) and return it as a PNG image. Optionally also keep it at `path`. Desktop app only (`designcraft-cli mcp --connect PORT`).
tool:screenshot.desc: Capture the whole app window (menus, panels, canvas) and return it as a PNG image. Optionally also keep it at `path`. Desktop app only (`designcraft-cli mcp --connect PORT`).

tool:select_tool.text0: Switch the active tool (as clicking it in the Tools panel). Ids: selection, directSelection, type, rectangleFrame, ellipseFrame, polygonFrame, rectangle, ellipse, polygon, line, hand, zoom, …
tool:select_tool.desc: Switch the active tool (as clicking it in the Tools panel). Ids: selection, directSelection, type, rectangleFrame, ellipseFrame, polygonFrame, rectangle, ellipse, polygon, line, hand, zoom, …

tool:set_story_text.text0: Replace the whole text of a story (keeps the first paragraph's and character's formatting). Use \n for paragraph breaks. Identify the story by `story` id or by a text `frame` id.
tool:set_story_text.desc: Replace the whole text of a story (keeps the first paragraph's and character's formatting). Use \n for paragraph breaks. Identify the story by `story` id or by a text `frame` id.

tool:type_text.text0: Type text at the text insertion point (as the keyboard would with the type tool), or into the focused dialog field in the desktop app. Put a caret first with pointer (tool "type") or execute text.placeCaret / text.select.
tool:type_text.desc: Type text at the text insertion point (as the keyboard would with the type tool), or into the focused dialog field in the desktop app. Put a caret first with pointer (tool "type") or execute text.placeCaret / text.select.

tool:ui_inspect.text0: UI state: active tool, panels, view (zoom, origin), canvas rect in screen points, window size, documents, open dialog, perf. Desktop app only (`designcraft-cli mcp --connect PORT`).
tool:ui_inspect.desc: UI state: active tool, panels, view (zoom, origin), canvas rect in screen points, window size, documents, open dialog, perf. Desktop app only (`designcraft-cli mcp --connect PORT`).

tool:ui_set.params: {baselineGrid?:boolean, brightness?:string, fit?:string, frameEdges?:boolean, guides?:boolean, page?:integer, panel?:string, rulers?:boolean, screenMode?:string, textThreads?:boolean, zoom?:number}
tool:ui_set.text0: Change UI state: panel to open, brightness, rulers/guides/frameEdges/baselineGrid/textThreads, screenMode, zoom, page (1-based), fit (page|spread). Desktop app only (`designcraft-cli mcp --connect PORT`).
tool:ui_set.desc: Change UI state: panel to open, brightness, rulers/guides/frameEdges/baselineGrid/textThreads, screenMode, zoom, page (1-based), fit (page|spread). Desktop app only (`designcraft-cli mcp --connect PORT`).

cmd:file.close.label: Close
cmd:file.close.desc: Close the currently open document or the file selected by index.

cmd:frame.thread.label: Thread Frames
cmd:frame.thread.params: {from: item id, to?: item id, rect?: [x0,y0,x1,y1], spread?} — thread `from` → `to`, or to a new empty text frame at `rect` (on `from`'s spread and layer, or `spread`) → {from, to, story}
cmd:frame.thread.desc: Link text flow from one frame to another frame or to a new frame so text continues between them.

tool:execute.text0: Run any DesignCraft command by id with JSON params (ids and params from list_commands). Examples: {"command":"frame.create","params":{"rect":[36,36,576,300],"content":"text","text":"Hello"}} → {id, story}; {"command":"type.char","params":{"size":24}}; {"command":"edit.undo"}. Coordinates are points in spread space. In the desktop app UI-only commands (view.*, window.*, app.*) work too.
tool:execute.desc: Run any DesignCraft command by id with JSON params (ids and params from list_commands). Examples: {"command":"frame.create","params":{"rect":[36,36,576,300],"content":"text","text":"Hello"}} → {id, story}; {"command":"type.char","params":{"size":24}}; {"command":"edit.undo"}. Coordinates are points in spread space. In the desktop app UI-only commands (view.*, window.*, app.*) work too.

note:check-before-delivery.label: Before calling a layout finished: check it
note:check-before-delivery.text0: Run craftmcp.py check designcraft (preflight: overset text, missing fonts, low-resolution images; plus items off the page and characters a font has no glyph for), then render a page and look at the image.
note:check-before-delivery.desc: Run craftmcp.py check designcraft (preflight: overset text, missing fonts, low-resolution images; plus items off the page and characters a font has no glyph for), then render a page and look at the image.

note:long-jobs-use-a-script.label: Long jobs belong in a script on the control channel
note:long-jobs-use-a-script.text0: A whole book or hundreds of commands: run a script against the app's control port instead of MCP calls, for example DESIGNCRAFT_PORT=$(craftmcp.py port designcraft) python projects/book_build/build.py <manifest>.
note:long-jobs-use-a-script.desc: A whole book or hundreds of commands: run a script against the app's control port instead of MCP calls, for example DESIGNCRAFT_PORT=$(craftmcp.py port designcraft) python projects/book_build/build.py <manifest>.

note:missing-glyph-fallback.label: Characters missing from a font are silently drawn with another font
note:missing-glyph-fallback.text0: DesignCraft draws characters the chosen font lacks (for example Cyrillic in a Latin-only typeface) with a fallback face and does not report a missing font: font.list and preflight show nothing. craftmcp.py check designcraft compares the text with the font files' glyph tables and names the letters.
note:missing-glyph-fallback.desc: DesignCraft draws characters the chosen font lacks (for example Cyrillic in a Latin-only typeface) with a fallback face and does not report a missing font: font.list and preflight show nothing. craftmcp.py check designcraft compares the text with the font files' glyph tables and names the letters.

note:new-frames-have-a-stroke.label: New frames come with a thin dark stroke
note:new-frames-have-a-stroke.text0: frame.create gives frames a default stroke. Remove it with object.stroke {swatch: 'None', ids: [frame ids]}; set a fill with object.fill {swatch, ids} after swatch.create.
note:new-frames-have-a-stroke.desc: frame.create gives frames a default stroke. Remove it with object.stroke {swatch: 'None', ids: [frame ids]}; set a fill with object.fill {swatch, ids} after swatch.create.

note:place-image-trap.label: Putting a picture on a page: deselect first
note:place-image-trap.text0: place_image fills the currently SELECTED empty or graphic frame, for example the background rectangle you just drew. Run edit.deselectAll first, then place_image {path, x, y, width}; the width argument alone does not size the frame, so select the new frame and use transform.set {x, y, width, height, ref: 0} and object.fit {mode: fitContentToFrame}.
